documents.title: Unsent Letter — No Address
documents.physical_description: Folded into an envelope that was never sealed. Handwriting careful at the beginning, rushed at the end. No address on the front.
documents.transcript:
Dear Masha,

I am writing this because I do not know when I will see you again. The buses came and went. I was not on them.

The apartment is cold. I have covered the windows with blankets. Your mother's plants are dead. I am sorry about the plants.

I have left money in the blue tin under the sink. There is also a key to the storage unit at the station. Inside you will find the winter clothes and the photograph album.

If you are reading this, I hope you are warm.

Papa

documents.title: Written Confession — No Name
documents.material: Back of a utility form, blue ink
documents.physical_description: Handwriting is steady. The author names a specific action, a specific place, and a specific consequence.
documents.transcript:
I took the medicine from the storeroom on Day 31.
I knew it was for the children's ward.
I sold it to the Scavengers for fuel.
My daughter was cold.
I would do it again.

I am writing this because someone will find it and someone will know.
I am not asking for forgiveness.
I am writing it down so it is recorded.

The medicine was antibiotics. Twelve doses.
The fuel lasted four days.

documents.title: Handwritten Will — Two Witnesses
documents.material: Lined paper, witnessed by two signatures
documents.physical_description: A will assigning specific items to specific people. One name has been crossed out and replaced.
documents.transcript:
LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT

I, Kovalenko, Roman Stepanovich, being of sound mind, do hereby bequeath:

To my wife, Kovalenko, Irina:
The blue tin with the money.
The storage key.
The photograph album.

To my son, Kovalenko, Andrei:
The watch. The compass. The knife.

To [CROSSED OUT] — [REPLACED] Dr. Vel:
The medical books. They will be more useful to you than to me.

Witnessed by:
Petrov, Dmitry — Day 48
Novikov, Fyodor — Day 48

[NOTE]
If Andrei is not alive, everything goes to the shelter.
Do not let the garrison take it.
